subject: Discovery: pricing bands, token targets & feature payback matrix
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Amy Turner <amy@avahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + pricing bands / next asks

Hi Amy — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our side and three asks so we can build a clean pricing + payback proposal for your team.

Recap (from today's demo & discovery)
- Primary feature: Automated visit summary (users paste visit notes -> summary + follow-up suggestions). Expected to be the first-to-market feature.
- Secondary: Symptom triage prompts + recommended resources (lower token/req).
- Expected pilot scope: 5–10 clinics, end users are care coordinators; ~6–8k MAUs across those clinics by Q4.
- Typical prompt shape: 600–1,200 tokens in / 200–400 tokens out for summary; triage ~200 tokens in/out.

Asks for proposal accuracy
1) Can you confirm expected MAUs for pilot (best estimate range) and any seasonality we should model?
2) Can you confirm target monthly spend envelope (ballpark $/month) or a target $/1M tokens that you’d consider reasonable?
3) Any hard constraints on CAC payback or margin targets we should know when sizing discounts/commitments?

Attached: feature-usage-estimates.xlsx (first pass from our side) and a blank mutual-action-plan. I’ll loop in Ben to run through unit economics assumptions and a couple of price band options once we have your ranges.

Proposed next step: if you can reply with MAU range + preferred $/1M target this week, Ben and I will return two proposal bands (conservative and aggressive) with explicit CAC payback scenarios and per-feature cost breakdown.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199

From: Amy Turner <amy@avahealth.com>

Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + pricing bands / next asks

Hi Stephanie — great summary, thanks. Quick answers below to help you model:

MAU / usage shape (pilot, month 1 baseline)
- Pilot MAU range: 4,500 — 7,500 (we’re more likely ~5.5k).
- Feature usage split: summaries ~45% of calls, triage ~35%, misc (search/FAQ) ~20%.
- Average calls per MAU per month: ~12 (care coordinators generate multiple summaries weekly).

Token assumptions (our rough telemetry)
- Summary: avg 850 tokens in, 300 tokens out -> ~1,150 tokens/transact.
- Triage: ~220 tokens total.
- Monthly token estimate (pilot mid): ~6.8M tokens/mo (summary heavy).

Budget and price target
- We have an initial pilot budget envelope of $8k–$14k/mo.
- Target $/1M tokens: ideally < $2,100 — if we can get near $1,500 that’s excellent but not required for pilot.

CAC / payback constraints
- We’re a cost-sensitive buyer; internal finance wants vendor CAC payback <= 12 months for pilot purchases. If you show strong LTV uplift by Q3, they’ll consider longer payback for expansion.

We’ll also need security questionnaire responses (attached in our outbound) — I attached the vendor security questionnaire; happy to sync with your security team if that helps.

Best,
Amy Turner
Head of Product | Ava Health
amy@avahealth.com

Attachments: security-questionnaire.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 07:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Pricing sketch + unit econ for Ava pilot (workback)

Internal note — sketching numbers so Steph can respond today. Assumptions taken from Amy's reply and our runtime cost model.

Assumptions (pilot mid case)
- Monthly tokens (mid): 6.8M tokens/mo
- Tokens by feature: summaries 55% (3.74M), triage 30% (2.04M), misc 15% (1.02M) [percent by token volume]
- Redwood cost to serve (baseline, quantized models + batching): $700 per 1M tokens (inference cost)
- Target gross margin goal for a standard pilot: 60–70% (lead with 65%)
- CAC payback target per Amy: <= 12 months; desirable for us to show <= 9 months to be competitive

Price math (workback)
- If we price at $1,800 per 1M tokens: revenue = 6.8 * $1.8k = $12,240/mo; cost = 6.8 * $700 = $4,760; gross margin = (12,240 - 4,760) / 12,240 = 61%.
- If we price at $1,300 per 1M tokens: revenue = $8,840/mo; cost = $4,760; margin = 46% (too low).
- To hit 70% margin on 6.8M tokens, price per 1M needs to be ~ $1,566. Calculation: price such that (price - 700)/price = 0.7 -> price = 700 / 0.3 = 2333 (wait — recalc below)

(Proper workback)
- Desired margin M (e.g., 0.7). Let p = price per 1M. Then (p - c)/p = M -> p = c / (1 - M). For c = $700/1M:
  - For M=0.65 -> p = 700 / 0.35 = $2,000 per 1M.
  - For M=0.60 -> p = 700 / 0.40 = $1,750 per 1M.
  - For M=0.70 -> p = 700 / 0.30 = $2,333 per 1M.

Implications / recommended bands
- Band A (Pilot-friendly): $1,300 per 1M (requires commitment/short term) -> margin ~46% (acceptable if we trade on expansion commitments).
- Band B (Balanced): $1,800 per 1M (est. margin ~61%) -> aligns with Amy's mid-target and sits in finance-friendly space.
- Band C (Premium SLA + dedicated capacity): $2,300+ per 1M -> >70% margin, for customers buying Dedicated or longer terms.

CAC payback workback (simple)
- Assume ARR uplift from feature drives 4x LTV/CAC target; if pilot converts to $60k ARR after expansion, to get payback <= 9 months CAC must be <= $45k approx. For pilot scope, we should price low enough to accelerate expansion and justify sales/CS spend.

Internal asks before we send proposal
1) Confirm whether we should include a 6-month minimum commitment discount vs month-to-month pricing.
2) Approve Band B as primary proposal and Band A as an aggressive option tied to a 6-mo commit.
3) I’ll prepare a redlined econ workbook and a per-feature $/feature runrate table for client visibility.

Ben
Ben Carter | Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Hi Amy — thanks for the quick details. Based on your MAU / token ranges I’ve attached a short workbook that shows three pricing bands (pilot / balanced / dedicated) and a per-feature $/month run-rate breakdown so you can see what drives cost. Short summary:

What we’ll send (by EOD Tuesday)
- Two proposal bands: Band A (pilot, 6-mo commit option) and Band B (balanced, month-to-month with a small commitment discount).
- Workbook includes per-feature $/month and $/1M token math, and CAC payback scenarios assuming 9–12 month targets.
- Security team will start on the questionnaire you attached; expect a response from our InfoSec lead in ~48 hours.

Confirm please: are you comfortable with us modeling $/1M tokens at $1,300 and $1,800 for the two bands (Ben's notes) — or should we center the bands nearer $1,500 and $2,000 as alternative anchors? If you’re fine with 1.3k/1.8k we’ll lock those and show the margin math.

Thanks again — short call to review the workbook is helpful once you’ve had a chance to scan it. Do you have 30 minutes Wed AM PST?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
